english: if you want peace, prepare for war
also: he who desires peace should prepare for war

evidence: Veg. Mil. 3 prol.: Igitur quī dēsīderat pācem, praeparet bellum
terms.comment: Vegetius’s sentence, from the preface to the third book of his manual of warfare; the familiar Sī vīs pācem, parā bellum is not his wording.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Vegetius, Epitoma rei militaris 3, preface, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
